title: EXP-101 - Hello World Part 7 Prerequisite: Two FX_ Images (FX_CustomerIcon.png, FX_CustomerSignIn.png) in the Image Library, Readback After Reopen
objective: Prepare Hello World Part 7 (customer portal), which uses the bitmaps customericon.png (07:38-07:46) and customersignin.png (12:49) and assumes they were imported earlier. With the EXP-099 method, add exactly two images to the Web Designer image library from the byte-identical FX_-named asset copies assets/FX_CustomerIcon.png and assets/FX_CustomerSignIn.png (the library names each entry after the uploaded file), commit with OK and one Designer Save, and verify both entries by reopening the library read-only with Display Option Fit. Never overwrite, export or remove an existing image. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Before browser interaction read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt7.md lines that mention customericon.png and customersignin.png, recipes/session/session-expiry-and-stale-designer.md, and only the final Outcome (operator) sections of the EXP-063-R2, EXP-099 and EXP-100 records (EXP-099 holds the proven image-library method). Do not read those records in full.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-101-hello-world-part-7-prereq-fx-customer-images.md and evidence/EXP-101/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task; never sign in inside the portal's embedded app frame (refused, EXP-080-R2) but use the procedure's top-level portal navigation. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt, menu or unsaved runtime change open across tasks. After any pause, inspect the state read-only before acting and never replay an earlier action.
Task boundary: do only what the current task instruction lists and stop at its end, even when later steps of this brief remain; report the next step instead of performing it.

Designer gate (read-only): the Designer is in User scope and no Form is open (EXP-100 ended with none); if a Form is open, record it, and if it is dirty or the session shows the server-event error, record it and stop blocked. Do not close or edit an open Form unless it is clean; a clean open Form may be closed once through its Form-tab control (fresh snapshot before the click; answer No to any save prompt and record its text).

Absence check (read-only): open Edit > Image once, set nothing, scroll the File list and record whether FX_CustomerIcon.png or FX_CustomerSignIn.png already exists (screenshot of the list around the FX_ entries). If either exists, record it and stop blocked. Leave the dialog with its Close Window (x) once and record any prompt.

Add the images: open Edit > Image once more and use New once per image, in this order: C:\AI\mongoose-factory\assets\FX_CustomerIcon.png, then C:\AI\mongoose-factory\assets\FX_CustomerSignIn.png. For each, use the EXP-099 method: take a fresh screenshot of the 'Get image for new.png' dialog, click its visible Select File button once with a coordinate click, supply the exact asset path with the file-upload tool once, verify the displayed file name and size, then click Upload once. Verify the new entry appears in the File list under its FX_ file name. Record any size limit or error verbatim; if an upload is rejected or the entry shows a name without the FX_ prefix, record it and stop blocked without retrying.

Commit: click the library OK once after both entries and record the native response verbatim; then perform exactly one Designer Save and record its response (EXP-099: 'Save - Global object(s) were saved.'). If Save is not enabled, record that and do not search for another commit route. Never retry a Save.

Readback (read-only): open Edit > Image once more, select each of FX_CustomerIcon.png and FX_CustomerSignIn.png by a view click, set Display Option to Fit (this did not dirty the Designer in EXP-099), and screenshot each preview. Compare with the assets as viewed by the operator assistant: FX_CustomerIcon = close-up of a white-and-black cat face; FX_CustomerSignIn = ginger cat facing a microphone held by a hand. Record any stored size or version caption shown. Leave the dialog with Close Window (x) once and verify no prompt and a clean Designer (Save disabled).

Capture screenshots of the Designer gate, the library list before any change, each upload dialog showing the chosen file, the list after each upload, the OK and Save responses, and each readback preview. Use a distinct filename for every capture; never overwrite an earlier screenshot.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task; after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references. Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.
